python_suite.command: uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

final_targeted_checks.command: uv run python -m unittest tests.test_foot_shank tests.test_body_plan tests.test_part_versions.PartVersions -v

browser.command: VIEWER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8021/ uv run --with playwright python tests/viewer_smoke.py
browser.scope: Initial selector, printed versions/status, four pads/no drive motors in walking mode, nominal screenshots, body backdrop, mirrored CAD/browser motion at roll -2/pitch +2/bend +2 degrees, parts and reset; no browser errors.

limits: Digital geometry, sampled clearance and local slicing only. No part was printed and no walking controller or gait has been validated.
